write_up: This is a strong store manager resume! Your progression at Carolina Home & Garden leads to a $9.4M store, and your recent work shows what changed in sales, turnover and shrink.

The turnover line is a model: it gives the before and after and names the scheduling change behind it. Your headline claims two store turnarounds, though the results shown are concentrated in the current role, so a recruiter may wonder what happened at the other store.

Start by adding the work behind that second turnaround, then give the earlier supervisor role a little more substance. For store manager jobs, your resume isn't likely to be the main thing holding you back; how competitive each opening is matters too.
